def test_closing_discards_operations_without_changing_other_live_rows():
    from Models import BasicModel

    lang = tuple(torch.ones(2, 4) for _ in range(26))
    _stm, cleared, _feedback = BasicModel._discard_sentence_record(((), lang, ()),

    for index in (4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25):

def test_missing_absorbed_operand_uses_bounded_compose_candidates(tmp_path):
    from Language import PartLayer
    model = _model(tmp_path)
    try:
        parent = torch.tensor([[.2, .7]])
        basis = torch.tensor([[[.1, .3], [.6, .2], [100., 100.]]])
        left, right, unavailable = model.languageSpace.reverse_binary_step(
            parent, torch.tensor([0]), torch.tensor([True]), ops=[PartLayer()],
            basis=basis, basis_valid=torch.tensor([[True, True, False]]),
            candidate_limit=2, return_status=True)
        assert not unavailable.any()
        # The parent contains no marker identity. This is the declared
        # ambiguous candidate mean, and never the parent's duplicate.
        torch.testing.assert_close(left, basis[:, :2].mean(1))
        torch.testing.assert_close(right, parent)
    finally:
        model.End()
        model.symbolSpace.soft_reset()

def test_missing_absorbed_operand_uses_bounded_compose_candidates(tmp_path):
    from Language import PartLayer
    model = _model(tmp_path)
    try:
        parent = torch.tensor([[.2, .7]])
        basis = torch.tensor([[[.1, .3], [.6, .2], [100., 100.]]])
        left, right, unavailable = model.languageSpace.reverse_binary_step(
            parent, torch.tensor([0]), torch.tensor([True]), ops=[PartLayer()],
            basis=basis, basis_valid=torch.tensor([[True, True, False]]),
            candidate_limit=2, return_status=True)
        assert not unavailable.any()
        # The parent contains no marker identity. The missing operand is
        # one hard least-residual candidate from the bounded valid rows.
        candidates = basis[:, :2]
        assert (left[:, None, :] == candidates).all(-1).any(-1).all()
        op = PartLayer()
        residuals = (op.compose(candidates, parent[:, None, :]) - parent[:, None, :]).square().mean(-1)
        residual = (op.compose(left, right) - parent).square().mean(-1)
        torch.testing.assert_close(residual, residuals.min(-1).values)
        torch.testing.assert_close(right, parent)
    finally:
        model.End()
        model.symbolSpace.soft_reset()
